contributions.original_prompts:
New raw `raw/stripe-payments-vouchers-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw `raw/stripe-vouchers-2025.md`. Current summaries `wiki/sources/source-stripe-vouchers.md`.

- Q1. For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/vouchers`, what documented behavior, prerequisites, actors and state transitions does the complete new capture establish? How do these compare with the matched prior capture and each mapped summary?

- Q2. Which changes are substantive, presentational or navigation-only? Identify the exact dated qualifications, conflicts and reciprocal routes that the proposed disposition should preserve.

reviewed_answers.Q1: https://docs.stripe.com/payments/vouchers describes voucher payment methods distinct from gift vouchers. At checkout buyers select a voucher method, get a digital reference and transaction details by email or app, pay at an authorized location often with cash, and receive completion notice after payment. Unpaid voucher issuance is provisional; customers might not pay and confirmation can take one business day. Refund coverage varies and some merchants create separate credit processes. The hub describes use for buyers without cards or bank accounts and as a fallback in lower-card-authorization markets (new raw lines 7–24, old raw lines 6–23). Both matrices include Boleto, Konbini, Multibanco and OXXO. All four list Connect, Checkout, Payment Links, Payment Element and Mobile Payment Element; none lists Express Checkout Element. Boleto alone lists Customer Portal. Boleto supports Subscriptions/Invoicing and setup; Konbini and Multibanco Subscription/Invoice support is send_invoice only; OXXO is excluded. Konbini and OXXO Checkout exclude subscription/setup modes. The Konbini Connect invite applies to on-behalf-of charges for other accounts. All use PaymentIntents and the four published enums, none supports manual capture, none is marked as requiring redirect in the hub API matrix, and only Boleto supports SetupIntents and setup_future_usage. The generic footnotes distinguish supported usage modes and possible return_url requirements; the page retains the Sources/Tokens-to-PaymentIntents migration route (new raw lines 26–50, old raw lines 25–49). source-stripe-vouchers.md accurately reports the basic enum, setup and invoicing matrix; its lines 13, 17, 28 and 32 need narrower channel, timing and redirect descriptions.
reviewed_answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/vouchers, the 2026-11-07 copy preserves the 2026-05-07 payment flow, matrix values/footnotes, and migration link (new raw lines 17–50, old raw lines 16–49). The November CDN image destination, discovery comment and table delimiters are presentational or asset navigation, with the same illustration alt text. Correct inherited summary drift apart from this raw delta: source-stripe-vouchers.md lines 13, 17 and 32 should describe channel and delay as method-dependent and keep the warning against fulfillment before confirmation; the companion Multibanco overview lines 9–11 includes online banking. Qualify line 28 as the hub API matrix, alongside dated Boleto Checkout's redirect to the hosted voucher and separate payment success. Boleto setup support does not establish off-session payment support, and the November Boleto overview lines 87–92 explicitly excludes it. Preserve the dated Konbini invite footnote at old raw lines 27–34 and new raw lines 28–35, alongside the distinct November method-specific Japanese platform own-account route rather than inferring the fate of on_behalf_of invitations. The listed method-country shorthand should not be read as merchant availability: the cross-method support matrix distinguishes those columns, including broader Multibanco merchant scope at line 58 than its PT customer location. Keep the May and November raw references and the Stripe index source/concept route at lines 372–373 through the root index. Keep the Cash Vouchers concept’s hub backlink at line 115 and method-specific source routes below it; add a reciprocal source-to-concept link when preparing any approved update.
